subject: Sentinel Innovations — SDK sync & eval playbook (LangChain / LlamaIndex tracing)
messages:
From: Kyle Dunn <kyle@sentinel-innovations.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: Maria Gomez <maria@atlasprompt.ai>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Sentinel SDK sync + tracing expectations

Hi Olga —

Thanks again for the quick intro call this week. Per our discussion, Sentinel is building a plugin-style SDK that lets customers wire upstream prompt tooling and observability into the runtime. We want to validate two things with Redwood:

1) A short POC that integrates Sentinel's trace headers into the LangChain sidecar and verifies token-level attribution via Redwood Trace Hook.
2) Guidance on recommended deployment profiles (dedicated vs hosted) for customers that need sub-50ms median generation and KV-cache forwarding.

I've attached a one-pager and the current SDK checklist for your review (sentinel_sdk_integration_checklist.xlsx). Proposed timing: 2-week sandbox, then an eval run with 3 sample prompt flows (retrieval + rerank + summarize).

Can you point us to the right person on the Redwood side to scope the test harness and the tracing contract (header names, sampling expectations)?

Cheers,
Kyle
Head of Integrations | Sentinel Innovations

Subject: Re: Sentinel SDK sync + tracing expectations

Kyle —

Appreciate the detail and the checklist. Jumping in to coordinate. Short answers up front: we can run a 2-week sandbox, and we have a Trace Hook that will accept custom trace header mapping (we typically support x-rw-trace-id + x-rw-span). For token attribution, we'll need you to include per-request prompt tokens in the trace payload (we can map to our token_count field).

Next steps I propose:
- Jonás to own the sandbox runtime config and provide a smoke test harness (LangChain & LlamaIndex examples).
- Marissa to own acceptance criteria and the eval prompt set.
- Olga to coordinate timelines and procurement note (if Dedicated capacity required).

Jonas / Marissa — can you take a look at the checklist Kyle sent and comment inline by EOD Monday? I'll schedule a 30m kickoff for Monday 10:30 PT.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Senior Partner Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, Kyle Dunn <kyle@sentinel-innovations.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 11 Apr 2027 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sentinel SDK sync + tracing expectations

Olga / Kyle —

Quick pass on the checklist:
- Sandbox: we'll provision a LangChain-compatible runtime image with an optional LlamaIndex loader and the tracehook sidecar. I'll commit a smoke test (python) that exercises: create session, send retrieval prompt, generate, and call rerank endpoint.
- Tracing: we prefer x-rw-trace-id and x-rw-span for sticky routing. We'll accept a sentinel_trace_id header and map it in the sidecar. Sampling: default 1% for user traffic; for the sandbox we'll sample 100% so you get full attribution.
- Quantization/Perf: if you expect <50ms median, we'll need to run on Dedicated T4x or A100 slices; we'll profile and give a recommendation.

I've uploaded a short script to the Drive link (see related_links) and added comments to the checklist (column G).

Jonás Weber
Runtime Integrations Engineer | Redwood Inference

Thanks team — quick clarifying items from our side before the kickoff:

- We use LlamaIndex for our retrieval pipelines; can the smoke tests include a vector store cold-start (so we can validate prefix KV warmups)?
- For prompts, we'll supply three canonical flows: FAQ lookup, multi-turn product assistant, and multi-doc summarize. Marissa — can you confirm whether we should aim for exact-match regression thresholds or relative quality (score delta)?
- Are there guardrails for exposing raw prompt text in traces in hosted mode? Some customers require prompt redaction.

We'll be ready for the 10:30 kickoff.

—Maria Gomez
Senior PM, Integrations | AtlasPrompt (partnering w/ Sentinel)
---
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, Kyle Dunn <kyle@sentinel-innovations.com>, Maria Gomez <maria@atlasprompt.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Apr 2027 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sentinel SDK sync + tracing expectations

All —

Thanks, this is great. Quick answers:
- Jonás: please include the LlamaIndex cold-start in the smoke tests (vector import + first-query latency).
- Quality metrics: let's use relative quality (delta) for the first eval run to account for model variance, but log exact-match metrics too. I'll publish a short eval spec in Drive after the kickoff.
- Prompt redaction: hosted mode will redact full prompt text by default when a customer requests it; we can surface redacted vs raw via field-level controls in the trace. For sandbox and Dedicated runs we'll provide raw traces unless the customer requests masking.

Action items for the kickoff:
1) Align on sample prompts and dataset (Marissa)
2) Agree tracing headers and sampling (Jonás)
3) Provision sandbox runtime + credentials (Olga)
4) Timeline: 2-week sandbox starting Apr 12 -> eval window Apr 26-30

I'll capture notes and share the eval spec link after the meeting.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Partner Success Manager | Redwood Inference
